name: Code metrics
description: Counts the files and lines of code in the conversation's workspace.
guidance: When the user asks how large or how much code a project has, use the code_metrics tool instead of counting files by hand.

tools.name: code_metrics
tools.description: Counts the files and the lines of code in the workspace, grouped by file extension.

path.description: A workspace-relative path to count. The whole workspace is counted when it is absent.
